summary: Ligand Pharmaceuticals (LGND) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire XOMA Royalty Corporation. Under the terms, each XOMA Royalty common share will receive $39.00 in cash plus contingent value rights (CVRs) tied to RemainCo LLC. The CVRs will be spun off pre-merger via a holding company reorganization. The board-supported deal implies a premium not explicitly stated in the excerpt. Closing mechanics involve a reverse triangular merger, with HoldCo surviving. Watch for CVR valuation, shareholder approval, and regulatory timelines for the spin-off and merger.
